'''The Nadir''' was a restaurant located onboard the Imperial refueling depot [[Bannistar Station]]. [[Arno D'Vox]], the station [[Commander/Legends|commander]], maintained a private dining room within the restaurant that had spectacular views of a [[Bannistar Station planetoid|nearby planetoid]], and in about [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], D'Vox invited the [[holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] to a meal with him in the restaurant.
